title: Concept: phpMyAdmin login interface disclosed
description: The phpMyAdmin login interface is served at this endpoint, so the database administration console is reachable and accepts credentials here.
applicability: Responses served by a phpMyAdmin deployment.
risk: A reachable phpMyAdmin is a credential-stuffing and known-CVE target with direct database access behind it; MEDIUM because the page itself is the login form and no session is established.
